questions.q_en: You report that the CH peptide, a product sold against drought, also confers salinity tolerance. What are the candidate molecular mechanisms, and which of them can your data actually distinguish?
questions.q_zh: 你們說 CH 胜肽這個主打乾旱的產品，在鹽逆境下也有耐受效果。可能的分子機制有哪些？而你們的數據真的分得出是哪一個嗎？
pages: plant#Testing the efficacy of commercial CH Bio peptide
questions.a_en: We cannot name one, and I want to be precise about why. 富肽2號 is a finished product and CH Biotech did not disclose its active components, so we treat it as a product-level comparison and not as evidence for any compound. What we have is timing. In trial 1, with twenty-five seedlings a condition, post-treatment gave the highest chlorophyll and fresh weight of the three timings at 100 millimolar sodium chloride. In trial 2 post-treatment again gave the strongest recovery at 100 millimolar, while co-treatment helped most at 75. Naming a mechanism would mean separating the preparation into components first, and we have not done that.
questions.a_zh: 我們講不出來，而我想把原因說精確。富肽2號是成品，正瀚生技沒有揭露有效成分，所以我們只把它當成產品層級的比較，不當成任何特定化合物的證據。我們手上有的是時機。trial 1 每個條件二十五株，100 mM NaCl 下事後處理的葉綠素和鮮重是三個時機裡最高的。trial 2 在 100 mM 下又是事後處理恢復最強，而 75 mM 時同時處理最有幫助。要講機制，得先把這個製劑分離成組分，這件事我們還沒做。
questions.trap_en: Reciting a mechanism out of the plant elicitor peptide literature as if it had been measured here. The CH preparation is not BoPEP4, its composition is undisclosed, and no mechanistic assay was run on it.
questions.trap_zh: 把 plant elicitor peptide 文獻上的機制背出來，講得好像自己量過。CH 的製劑不是 BoPEP4，成分未揭露，我們也沒對它做過機制性實驗。
questions.author: Kyle Peng
questions.basis: from Kyle Peng's 24 Oct research-highlights note, CH peptide mechanism inquiry

questions.q_en: How do you experimentally exclude the confounding hypothesis that a protectant preparation acted simply as a nitrogen-rich nutrient source, that is, a fertilisation effect rather than protection?
questions.q_zh: 你們怎麼用實驗排除另一個解釋：保護劑製劑其實只是含氮的營養來源，也就是施肥效果，而不是保護效果？
questions.a_en: Partly, and I will say which part. On agar, sets 9, 10 and 11 put TB medium on the control plates to stand in for the bacterial culture without protectant, and in hydroponics every protectant run carried a 1/40 untransformed WB800 control, which is B. subtilis in TB medium with no protectant, specifically to separate the carrier from the protein. Those controls do rule out the medium. They do not rule out nitrogen, because none is matched to what a working enzyme releases. And set 4 shows a nutrient-type effect is real here: trehalose raised fresh weight in the unstressed plants. A nitrogen-matched arm would close it.
questions.a_zh: 部分排除了，我直接說是哪一部分。瓊脂上 set 9、10、11 的對照盤加的是 TB 培養基，用來代表沒有保護劑的菌液；水耕每一次保護劑實驗都帶一組 1/40 未轉型的 WB800，也就是 TB 培養基裡的 B. subtilis 但沒有保護劑，就是為了把載體和蛋白分開。這些對照確實排除了培養基，但沒有排除氮，因為沒有一組的氮量是跟一個正在作用的酵素所釋放的量配對的。而 set 4 顯示營養型的效果在我們系統裡是真的：trehalose 讓沒有逆境的植株鮮重上升。要關掉這個問題，需要一組等氮量的對照。
questions.trap_en: Claiming the TB medium control already rules out a nutrient effect. It controls for the carrier, not for the nitrogen the enzyme reaction releases.
questions.trap_zh: 說 TB 培養基對照已經排除了營養效果。那控制的是載體，不是酵素反應釋放出來的氮。
questions.author: Kyle Peng
questions.basis: from Kyle Peng's 24 Oct research-highlights note, fertilisation-effect confound

questions.q_en: Your enzyme's own reaction products are ammonia and alpha-ketobutyrate. On a plate, how do you separate ACC deaminase activity from the nitrogen the reaction releases?
questions.q_zh: 你們這個酵素的反應產物本身就是氨和 alpha-ketobutyrate。在平板上，你們怎麼把 ACC deaminase 的活性跟反應放出來的氮分開？
pages: measurement#DNPH assay for ACC deaminase activity
questions.a_en: We have not separated them, and it is a fair worry, because ammonia is a product of the reaction. ACC deaminase cleaves ACC into alpha-ketobutyrate and ammonia, and we read both: the DNPH assay measures the alpha-ketobutyrate and the indophenol blue assay measures the ammonia. On a plate that same ammonia is nitrogen. Our controls are TB medium, a 1/40 untransformed WB800 supernatant, and PLP alone, and none of them is matched to the nitrogen a turning-over enzyme would release. The clean separation is a catalytically dead enzyme at the same concentration, which our anti-His ELISA could match, or ammonium added to the control.
questions.a_zh: 我們沒有分開，而這個質疑很合理，因為氨就是反應產物。ACC deaminase 把 ACC 切成 alpha-ketobutyrate 和氨，而這兩個產物我們都讀：DNPH 測 alpha-ketobutyrate，indophenol blue 測氨。放到平板上，同一份氨就是氮。我們的對照是 TB 培養基、1/40 未轉型 WB800 上清液，還有單獨的 PLP，沒有一組的氮量跟一個正在催化的酵素所釋放的量配對。乾淨的分法是用一個失去催化活性的酵素，濃度用我們的 anti-His ELISA 配對，或者直接在對照組補上銨。
questions.trap_en: Saying the amount is too small to matter. We have never put a number on the ammonia delivered onto a plate, so we cannot claim it is negligible.
questions.trap_zh: 說「量太小不重要」。我們從來沒算過一個平板上帶進多少氨，所以不能說它可以忽略。
questions.author: Kyle Peng
questions.basis: from Kyle Peng's 24 Oct research-highlights note, nitrogen-source confound applied to ACCD

questions.q_en: Resource allocation theory posits a trade-off between vegetative growth rate and stress tolerance. Did your tolerance gains come with a fitness cost, and in which arm of your design would that cost appear?
questions.q_zh: 資源分配理論認為營養生長速率和逆境耐受之間會有取捨。你們拿到的耐受性有付出代價嗎？如果有，會出現在你們設計的哪一組？
pages: plant#Evaluating ACC deaminase rescue efficacy under prolonged 37 °C heat stress
questions.a_en: Yes, in some protectants and at some timings, and we can show it because every run carries an unstressed row. Under heat, post-treatment ACC deaminase grew like the control while pre- and co-treatment reduced fresh weight. In hydroponics without salt, BoPEP4 from 1/40 to 1/100 accumulated anthocyanin while the matched 1/40 WB800 and 0.1 times MS controls did not, which we read as BoPEP4 inhibiting growth when no stress is applied. The carrier has a cost too: WB800 culture alone stunted plants until we diluted it at least sixteen-fold. What we cannot speak to is lifetime fitness, because we score at day twelve to seventeen.
questions.a_zh: 有，在某些保護劑和某些時機下有，而我們看得到是因為每一次實驗都有一排沒有逆境的組。熱逆境下，事後處理的 ACC deaminase 長得跟對照一樣，而預先和同時處理讓鮮重下降。水耕沒有加鹽的那組，BoPEP4 從 1/40 到 1/100 都累積花青素，而配對的 1/40 WB800 和 0.1 倍 MS 對照沒有，我們解讀成沒有逆境時 BoPEP4 可能抑制生長。載體本身也有代價：單獨的 WB800 菌液會讓植株變小，所以我們至少稀釋十六倍。我們講不到的是整個生命週期的適存度，因為我們在第十二到十七天就判讀了。
questions.trap_en: Answering with the rescue numbers only. The question is about the unstressed row, and ours shows real costs for BoPEP4 and for pre- and co-treatment ACC deaminase.
questions.trap_zh: 只拿拯救效果的數字回答。問的是沒有逆境那一排，而我們在 BoPEP4 和預先、同時處理的 ACC deaminase 上都看到真實代價。
questions.author: Kyle Peng
questions.basis: from Kyle Peng's 24 Oct research-highlights note, growth versus tolerance trade-off

questions.q_en: Did the tolerance gain compromise defence against biotic stresses, such as phytophagous insects or pathogens? BoPEP4 in particular is an elicitor, so what would you predict?
questions.q_zh: 耐受性提升會不會犧牲對生物性逆境的防禦，例如食植性昆蟲或病原菌？尤其 BoPEP4 是個 elicitor，你們預期會怎樣？
questions.a_en: We did not test it. Eleven agar and two soil salinity sets, three agar and two soil heat sets, and no insect or pathogen challenge in any of them, so I have no measurement to give you. What we can reason is the direction. BoPEP4 is a plant elicitor peptide read by PEPR1 and PEPR2, which recruit the co-receptor BAK1 and switch on defence, so we would expect biotic defence to rise and growth to pay for it, rather than the reverse. That fits what we saw without stress, where BoPEP4 accumulated anthocyanin. The microbes we actually met were contamination in plates and hydroponic boxes, which is a confound, not a challenge.
questions.a_zh: 我們沒有測。鹽逆境做了十一組瓊脂和兩組土壤，熱逆境三組瓊脂和兩組土壤，沒有一組做過昆蟲或病原菌的挑戰，所以我拿不出量測結果。我們能推理的是方向。BoPEP4 是 plant elicitor peptide，由 PEPR1 和 PEPR2 辨識，再招募共受體 BAK1 啟動防禦，所以我們預期生物性防禦會上升、生長來付代價，而不是反過來。這也跟我們在沒有逆境時看到的一致，BoPEP4 那幾組累積了花青素。我們真正遇到的微生物是平板和水耕盒裡的污染，那是干擾因子，不是挑戰實驗。
questions.trap_en: Treating plate contamination as a biotic-stress result. It wrecked runs; it was never a controlled challenge.
questions.trap_zh: 把平板污染當成生物性逆境的結果。它毀了幾次實驗，但從來不是有控制的挑戰實驗。
questions.author: Kyle Peng
questions.basis: from Kyle Peng's 24 Oct research-highlights note, biotic-defence half of the trade-off question

questions.q_en: What are the stability profiles and degradation half-lives of your bioprotectants in soil, in hydroponic medium and on a foliar surface?
questions.q_zh: 你們的生物保護劑在土壤、水耕液和葉表面上的穩定性和降解半衰期各是多少？
questions.a_en: We have one number and it is not for any of the three places you named. Two readings by different routes, one in live culture and one across a twenty-eight hour reaction, put the apparent half-time of the secreted protectant at 0.7 to 1.5 hours. Neither is replicated and both sit near the limits of the assay, so our model carries it as provisional, but the direction matters: on that timescale activity is too short to bank. Soil, hydroponic medium and the leaf surface are all unmeasured, shelf life has no direct measurement, and the two-day protection window our dosing assumes is an assumption, not a result.
questions.a_zh: 我們有一個數字，但不是您問的那三個場所。兩個不同途徑的讀值，一個在活菌培養裡，一個是二十八小時的反應，把分泌出來的保護劑表觀半衰期放在 0.7 到 1.5 小時。兩個都沒有重複，而且都接近測定極限，所以我們的模型只當它是暫定值；但方向很重要：在那個時間尺度上，活性短到沒辦法先做好存起來。土壤、水耕液和葉表面三個都沒有量，保存期限沒有直接量測，而我們劑量計算裡假設的兩天保護窗是假設，不是結果。
questions.trap_en: Quoting 0.7 to 1.5 hours as if it described the protectant on a leaf. It bounds activity in the vessel; a harvested, cooled or formulated preparation is unmeasured.
questions.trap_zh: 把 0.7 到 1.5 小時講成葉子上的情況。那是框住反應槽裡的活性，收下來、冷藏或配製過的樣品都沒量過。
questions.author: Kyle Peng
questions.basis: from Kyle Peng's 24 Oct research-highlights note, stability and degradation half-life inquiry

questions.q_en: Is there empirical evidence confirming cellular uptake and systemic translocation of these intact molecules by the host plant?
questions.q_zh: 有沒有實驗證據證明這些分子是以完整形式被植物吸收進細胞，並在體內運輸？
kw_zh: 我們自己承認根吸收差
questions.a_en: None. We have no label, no immunolocalisation and no tissue fractionation, so we have never shown an intact molecule entering a cell or moving between tissues. The nearest thing on our wiki is an admission rather than evidence: we sprayed ACC deaminase onto shoots because it is a larger enzyme and is absorbed through roots with difficulty. That sentence concedes exactly the problem you are pointing at. Our anti-His ELISA does put a concentration on the protein, between 3.4 and 6.5 micrograms per millilitre across both October reactor runs, but that is protein in the culture and says nothing about where it goes on a plant.
questions.a_zh: 沒有。我們沒有做標記、沒有免疫定位、沒有組織分離，所以從來沒有證明完整分子進到細胞裡或在組織之間移動。我們 wiki 上最接近的一句不是證據而是承認：我們把 ACC deaminase 噴在地上部，是因為它是比較大的酵素，經由根吸收比較困難。那句話正好承認了您指出的問題。我們的 anti-His ELISA 確實量到濃度，兩次十月反應器運轉都在每毫升 3.4 到 6.5 微克之間，但那是培養液裡的蛋白，講不到它上了植物之後去哪裡。
questions.trap_en: Offering the ELISA concentration as uptake evidence. It counts His-tagged protein in culture medium, not in plant tissue.
questions.trap_zh: 拿 ELISA 的濃度當吸收證據。它數的是培養液裡帶 His tag 的蛋白，不是植物組織裡的。
questions.author: Kyle Peng
questions.basis: from Kyle Peng's 24 Oct research-highlights note, uptake and systemic translocation inquiry

questions.q_en: Most high-molecular-weight proteins cannot passively traverse the plant cell wall. By what mechanism, then, does exogenous ACC deaminase provide abiotic stress tolerance, given the enzyme's native intracellular localisation and its substrate accessibility?
questions.q_zh: 大多數高分子量蛋白無法被動穿過植物細胞壁。那麼考慮到這個酵素原生的胞內定位和底物可及性，外源施用的 ACC deaminase 是透過什麼機制賦予非生物逆境耐受的？
pages: measurement#PLP is what makes the enzyme work
kw_zh: 沒有 PLP 就沒活性
questions.a_en: Our reading is that it does not have to get in. The review we build on has plant-growth-promoting bacteria degrading ACC into ammonia and alpha-ketobutyrate outside the plant, which lowers the ACC available for ethylene and keeps growth going under salinity, so the substrate is ACC that has already left the root. On that account the cell wall is not the barrier for this enzyme. There is a condition and our own assay found it: without added PLP our construct turned substrate over no faster than the untransformed host. So wherever the enzyme works, the cofactor has to be there too, which is why PLP goes in with every dose.
questions.a_zh: 我們的理解是它不需要進去。我們依據的那篇回顧，講的是促生菌在植物外面把 ACC 分解成氨和 alpha-ketobutyrate，降低可用來做乙烯的 ACC，讓植物在鹽逆境下還能生長，所以底物是已經從根分泌出來的 ACC。照這個說法，細胞壁對這個酵素不是障礙。但有一個條件，是我們自己的測定找到的：沒有外加 PLP 時，我們的構築體轉化底物的速度跟未轉型的宿主一樣。所以酵素在哪裡作用，輔因子就得在那裡，這也是為什麼每一次給藥都一起加 PLP。
questions.trap_en: Arguing the enzyme enters the cell. The whole point of the rhizosphere account is that it acts on ACC already outside the root, and it needs PLP there as well.
questions.trap_zh: 硬說酵素會進到細胞裡。根圈那套說法的重點是它作用在已經在根外的 ACC，而且 PLP 也得在那裡。
questions.author: Kyle Peng
questions.basis: from Kyle Peng's 24 Oct research-highlights note, cell-wall barrier and ACCD localisation inquiry

questions.q_en: You sprayed the enzyme onto shoots. The rhizosphere account you have just described is a root-zone argument, so how does a sprayed leaf fit the mechanism you are claiming?
questions.q_zh: 你們是把酵素噴在地上部的。你剛說的根圈機制是根部的論證，那噴在葉子上要怎麼和你主張的機制對得上？
questions.a_en: Our stated reason is honest but it cuts against us: we sprayed because ACC deaminase is a larger enzyme and is absorbed through roots with difficulty. So the route we chose is the one where the rhizosphere account does not apply, and the route where it does apply is the one we could not interpret. In hydroponics the enzyme goes into the root medium, which is the right geometry, but you pointed out after that run that we had not standardised the culture volume between groups, so a higher enzyme dose came with more medium. We could not separate the two, and we say on the page that the run cannot support a conclusion.
questions.a_zh: 我們寫出來的理由很誠實，但其實對我們不利：我們噴是因為 ACC deaminase 是比較大的酵素，經由根吸收比較困難。所以我們選的路線剛好是根圈機制不適用的那條，而真正適用的那條我們又解讀不了。水耕是把酵素加進根部培養液，那個幾何是對的，但您在那次之後指出我們沒有把各組的菌液體積統一，所以酵素劑量越高、培養液也越多。這兩者分不開，我們也在頁面上寫了這一次沒辦法支持結論。
questions.trap_en: Defending the spray as the intended field route. The reason we gave for spraying is that root uptake is hard, which is a concession, not a mechanism.
questions.trap_zh: 把噴灑講成原本設計的田間施用方式。我們給的理由是根吸收困難，那是讓步，不是機制。
questions.author: Kyle Peng
questions.basis: derived from Kyle Peng's 24 Oct note: his substrate-accessibility point pressed on the foliar route

questions.q_en: Glutathione is known to enhance adaptation to heat, salinity and drought. Do your three bioprotectants act through glutathione-related pathways, or by upregulating the plant's own glutathione homeostasis?
questions.q_zh: Glutathione 已知可以提升植物對高溫、鹽害和乾旱的適應。你們這三種生物保護劑是走 glutathione 相關的路徑，還是靠提升植物自己的 glutathione 恆定？
questions.a_en: We never measured it, so I cannot answer directly. But the question sits closer to our work than it looks, because the thermo-priming protocol our whole heat assay is built on comes from Auverlot and colleagues, and their evidence is in glutathione biosynthesis mutants. So the experiment is already named for us: run our five-day 37 degree protocol on those mutants and see whether the protectant still rescues. On mechanism I would reason rather than claim. The three target different proximal things, ethylene, protein damage and defence signalling, so a shared glutathione node would be downstream convergence. The reduced to oxidised ratio is the first measurement.
questions.a_zh: 我們沒有量過，所以我沒辦法直接回答。但這個問題其實比看起來更貼近我們的工作，因為我們整個熱逆境實驗所依據的 thermo-priming 流程來自 Auverlot 等人，而他們的證據就是在 glutathione 生合成突變體上。所以實驗其實已經被指定好了：把我們 37 度五天的流程跑在那些突變體上，看保護劑還救不救得起來。機制上我只能推論，不敢斷言。這三個近端標的不一樣，分別是乙烯、蛋白受損和防禦訊息，所以共用 glutathione 這個節點會是下游的匯聚。第一步要量的是還原態和氧化態的比例。
questions.trap_en: Asserting an antioxidant mechanism because chlorophyll was retained. Retained chlorophyll is consistent with many pathways and identifies none.
questions.trap_zh: 因為葉綠素有保留就斷定是抗氧化機制。葉綠素保留和很多路徑都相容，指不出任何一條。
questions.author: Kyle Peng
questions.basis: from Kyle Peng's 24 Oct research-highlights note, shared GSH-pathway inquiry

questions.q_en: Your first highlight credits crude, unpurified ACC deaminase and BoPEP4 from your own bioreactor with the anticipated protective effects. State precisely what that rests on, and where it stops.
questions.q_zh: 你們第一個重點把預期的保護效果歸給自家生物反應器產出的粗製、未純化 ACC deaminase 和 BoPEP4。請精確說明這個結論建立在什麼上，又在哪裡停住。
questions.a_en: It rests on phenotype, and it stops at activity. On agar, pre-treatment ACC deaminase under 100 millimolar sodium chloride held about 1.74 against about 1.03 milligrams per gram in the untreated control, roughly seventy per cent more chlorophyll, tested by one-way ANOVA with Dunnett's test. In hydroponics BoPEP4 at 1/40 kept every plant green under the same salt, while the matched carrier control did not. Where it stops is that ACC deaminase activity in the material we applied was never quantified, so we cannot say how much working enzyme reached those plants. Each condition was one plate, and both results need replication.
questions.a_zh: 它建立在表徵上，停在活性。瓊脂上 100 mM NaCl 下，預先處理的 ACC deaminase 保留每克約 1.74 毫克，未處理對照約 1.03 毫克，大約多七成的葉綠素，用 one-way ANOVA 加 Dunnett 檢定。水耕裡 1/40 的 BoPEP4 在同樣鹽濃度下每一株都保持綠色，而配對的載體對照沒有。停住的地方是：我們施用的那批材料裡 ACC deaminase 的活性從來沒有定量，所以我們說不出有多少能作用的酵素真的到了那些植物上。而且每個條件只有一個平板，這兩個結果都需要重複驗證。
questions.trap_en: Quoting 70% more chlorophyll and stopping there. The judge's next question is how much active enzyme was in the spray, and we do not know.
questions.trap_zh: 講完「葉綠素多七成」就停住。評審下一句會問噴上去的裡面有多少有活性的酵素，而我們不知道。
questions.author: Kyle Peng
questions.basis: from Kyle Peng's 24 Oct research-highlights note, laboratory-production highlight and its limit

questions.q_en: Crude culture or purified protein, which is your active ingredient? And what does working with a crude preparation cost you in attribution?
questions.q_zh: 你們的有效成分到底是粗製培養液還是純化蛋白？用粗製品做實驗，在歸因上讓你們付出什麼代價？
questions.a_en: Concentration we have; purity and activity we do not. Our anti-His ELISA puts ACC deaminase at 3.4 to 6.5 micrograms per millilitre through both October reactor runs, present from the first hour with no rise over time. But the purification and dialysis protocol produced no result on our wiki, and what went onto plants was supernatant through a 0.22 micron filter, which is sterilisation rather than purification. The ELISA counts His-tagged protein and says nothing about whether it folds or turns substrate over, which is what the DNPH assay is for, and that activity is still unquantified. Crude suits a farm, but it costs us attribution.
questions.a_zh: 濃度我們有，純度和活性沒有。我們的 anti-His ELISA 在兩次十月反應器運轉裡把 ACC deaminase 定在每毫升 3.4 到 6.5 微克，從第一個小時就測得到，而且沒有隨時間上升。但純化與透析的流程在我們 wiki 上沒有產出結果，而施到植物上的是通過 0.22 µm 濾膜的上清液，那是除菌不是純化。ELISA 數的是帶 His tag 的蛋白，講不到它有沒有正確折疊或能不能轉化底物，那是 DNPH 的工作，而那個活性目前還沒有定量。粗製品適合農場，但代價是歸因。
questions.trap_en: Saying the 0.22 micron filter made it pure, or offering the ELISA concentration as proof of activity. The wiki itself keeps those two numbers apart.
questions.trap_zh: 說 0.22 µm 過濾之後就純了，或者拿 ELISA 的濃度當活性的證明。我們 wiki 自己就把這兩個數字分開寫。
questions.author: Kyle Peng
questions.basis: derived from Kyle Peng's 24 Oct note: his crude-preparation highlight read as an active-ingredient question

questions.q_en: Your second highlight says sequence-modified protectants maintained bioactivity. Which modification was tested, and if a variant performs like wild type, is that evidence of robustness or of a method that cannot resolve a difference?
questions.q_zh: 你們第二個重點說經過序列修改的保護劑仍保有活性。實際測的是哪一個修改？而如果變異體表現和野生型一樣，那是穩健的證據，還是你們的方法本來就分不出差別？
kw_zh: S15A 和 G17A 是對照
questions.a_en: I have to separate three things that the word modified runs together. The codon optimisation recodes only the first fifteen codons, to loosen the mRNA at the translation start, so not one amino acid changes and bioactivity could not change. The real protein-level change is the BoPEP4 truncation, which is registered and still in draft; we hold both lengths and have not run the head-to-head titre. And S15A and G17A are not activity-preserving variants, they are loss-of-function controls we ordered on published activities roughly a hundredfold and over four thousandfold below wild type. On your second half, our own audit found the docking score is ninety-three per cent explained by length and charge, and correlates with measured activity at rho about plus 0.05.
questions.a_zh: 我得把「修改」這個詞混在一起的三件事分開。密碼子最佳化只重新編碼前十五個密碼子，目的是鬆開轉譯起始處的 mRNA，一個胺基酸都沒變，活性本來就不會變。真正在蛋白層級的改動是 BoPEP4 的截短，它已登錄但還是草稿；兩個長度我們都有，但還沒跑過一對一的產量比較。而 S15A 和 G17A 根本不是保有活性的變異體，是我們依照已發表資料訂來當失活對照的，活性大約比野生型低一百倍和四千倍以上。至於您的後半段，我們自己的審核發現 docking 分數有九成三可以用長度和電荷解釋，而它和實測活性的相關性 rho 大約只有 +0.05。
questions.trap_en: Letting codon optimisation count as a sequence modification that preserved activity, or presenting S15A and G17A as variants that worked. They were built to fail.
questions.trap_zh: 把密碼子最佳化算成「保有活性的序列修改」，或把 S15A 和 G17A 說成有效的變異體。那兩個本來就是設計成失活的。
questions.author: Kyle Peng
questions.basis: derived from Kyle Peng's 24 Oct note: his structural-modification highlight read as a method-resolution question

questions.q_en: You propose isolating active polypeptide motifs and scaling up toward field application. In practice, what breaks first when you try that?
questions.q_zh: 你們打算分離出有活性的短序列，再往田間規模放大。實際上，這條路最先卡在哪裡？
questions.a_en: Replication breaks first, then efficacy, then litres. Each condition in our sets was a single plate, so our own stated next steps are independent replicates, a consistent treatment protocol, proper controls and a dose-response series for ACC deaminase. Efficacy is unbounded: no plant run of ours says how much of a salinity loss the protectant takes back, so the model carries it as an axis and never at a value. On litres, three sprays delivered 1.67 millilitres onto a 78.5 square centimetre plate, which is 2,126 litres a hectare and 37.6 kilounits per application, and ten twenty-litre reactors need 5.4 days against a three-day forecast.
questions.a_zh: 最先卡的是重複次數，接著是效力，再來是公升數。我們每個條件只有一個平板，所以我們自己寫下來的下一步就是獨立重複、統一的處理流程、適當的對照，還有 ACC deaminase 的劑量反應曲線。效力目前沒有上下界：我們沒有任何一次植物實驗能說出保護劑把鹽害損失救回多少，所以模型只能把它當成一個軸，從來不給定值。公升數上，三噴送出 1.67 毫升到 78.5 平方公分的平板，換算是每公頃 2,126 公升、每次施用 37.6 kU，而十台二十公升的反應器需要 5.4 天，對上只有三天的預報。
questions.trap_en: Answering with biology only. The binding constraints here are independent replication and an unbounded efficacy term, not whether an active motif can be found.
questions.trap_zh: 只用生物學回答。真正的瓶頸是獨立重複和沒有界限的效力項，不是找不找得到有活性的序列。
